statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If there is an ongoing INVITE client transaction, the TU MUST wait until the transaction reaches the completed or terminated state before initiating the new INVITE.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: a UAC MUST NOT initiate a new INVITE transaction within a dialog while another INVITE transaction is in progress in either direction.
statements.guard_semantics: New INVITE may only be initiated when no other INVITE transaction is in progress in either direction within the dialog

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If there is an ongoing INVITE client transaction, the TU MUST wait until the transaction reaches the completed or terminated state before initiating the new INVITE.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: If there is an ongoing INVITE server transaction, the TU MUST wait until the transaction reaches the confirmed or terminated state before initiating the new INVITE.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: If a UA receives a non-2xx final response to a re-INVITE, the session parameters MUST remain unchanged, as if no re-INVITE had been issued.

statements.subject: session
statements.description: if the non-2xx final response is a 481 (Call/Transaction Does Not Exist), or a 408 (Request Timeout), or no response at all is received for the re-INVITE (that is, a timeout is returned by the INVITE client transaction), the UAC will terminate the dialog.

statements.subject: timer
statements.description: If a UAC receives a 491 response to a re-INVITE, it SHOULD start a timer with a value T chosen as follows: if the UAC is the owner of the Call-ID, T is between 2.1 and 4 seconds; otherwise T is between 0 and 2 seconds.

statements.subject: transaction
statements.description: When the timer fires, the UAC SHOULD attempt the re-INVITE once more, if it still desires for that session modification to take place.
